_doc: Console fields for a Verda Serverless Containers BATCH JOB deployment (docs.verda.com/containers/batch-jobs/, page updated 02.11.2026). TEMPLATE ONLY - not applied. Nothing has been created on Verda.
compute_type: AMD Rome+ (8 vCPU, 32 GB) - CPU; the model is numpy and needs no GPU
registry_credentials: Verda Container Registry credential vcr-<PROJECT_ID>+tasan-pull (name + secret), entered in the New deployment page
location: pick a Finnish location (FIN-01/02/03) in the console if offered for Serverless Containers; GPU/CPU pool locations are not documented - check at deploy time
result: GET https://tasks.verda.com/result/tasan-twin  (header X-Inference-Id) -> the job's JSON output
